title: Root-revocation statement (v1)
description: A statement revoking a root key, accepted by clients only when signed by an embedded root; clients persist it irreversibly. Root revocation is total — no revoked-from grace: every chain under the revoked root dies, and re-signing under the surviving root restores legitimate bundles. It travels with the key directory and is also embedded in subsequent app builds. The root object is the wire form; `payload` is base64 of the exact signed bytes, which decode to a JSON object valid against `#/$defs/payload`. Root-signed directly, so the envelope carries no chain.

revokedFrom.description: Unix time in seconds, UTC. Recorded for the audit trail only — clients apply root revocation totally, ignoring timestamps (a stolen root can backdate anything).

ed25519Signature.description: base64 of a raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
